propositions: Token usage (input/output/cache tokens and request count) from LLM calls in the external and eval-live weekly jobs is not surfaced or persisted; logs are swallowed by NullHandler and the Langfuse trace backend is ephemeral.
PydanticAIRunner.run already computes and attaches usage to result["_usage"] but this record is dropped by eval.run_eval (returns only passed/coverage/junit) and pytest, and never reaches either job.

A new module usage_log.py with record() and summarize() functions must capture usage at the _usage seam in runner.py when env var REBAR_USAGE_LOG is set, append JSONL lines per call, and provide a CLI to generate Markdown summaries.

Both workflows (external-integration.yml and prompt-eval.yml) must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG, call the CLI summarize to append Markdown to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with if: always(), and upload the raw JSONL as a durable artifact.
